detail.rationale: The root blocker (pid 11001, batch_replayable_inventory) has held its transaction for only 4.0s (DB-1). Checkout is degraded (82% success vs 95% SLO, $3,286/min at risk per BIZ-3) but the business tolerates up to 60s of degradation (BIZ-3). Before deciding to terminate or escalate, I need the workload registry to confirm replayability and interrupt policy, the tradeoff calculation to quantify wait vs interrupt cost, and protected settlements to ensure no in-flight payments are endangered. Acting without these probes risks unnecessary disruption to a potentially short-lived batch job.
